roa.docketEntryComment: /CAL:PAROLE'S PETITION TO REVOKE OR MODIFY PAROLE PURSUANT TO PC3000,08/PDP/WIAPTR/3000ADV/3000ADM/3000REIN/PAJ:90 DAYS /X:PAROLEE SHALL RECEIVE CREDIT FOR  14  DAYS,/4019HALF/X:THE COURT DISMISSES VIOLATIONS #2 - ABSCONDING, FOR LACK OF EVIDENCE,/X:CLIENT MAY SERVE HER SENTENCE THROUGH A RESIDENTIAL DRUG TREATMENT PROGRAM, CLIENT MUST COMPLETE 6 MONTHS OF ACTUAL TREATMENT AT FOTEP,  SHE WILL BE TRANSPORTED TO THE PROGRAM BY THE SHERIFF'S DEPARTMENT,  A BED WILL BE AVAILABLE FOR CLIENT ON TUESDAY, APRIL 1, 2014,  THIS HAS BEEN CONFIRMED BY KAREN TOW OF FOTEP,  ADULT PAROLE HAS THE DISCRETION TO MODIFY TREATMENT, CHANGE THE TREATMENT PROGRAM, SEND PAROLEE INTO ADETOX FACILITY IN THE EVENTOF A RELAPSE AND IMPLEMENT ANY OTHER THERAPEUTICMEASURE AS DEEMED APPROPRIATE DURING THE 6 MONTHS OF TREATMENT,  IF CLIENTFAILS TO COMPLETE 6 MONTHS OF ACTUAL TREATMENT WITHOUT A LAWFUL JUSTIFICATION, SHE WILL BE REMANDED INTO CUSTODY ON THIS PETITION TO SERVE HER JAIL SENTENCE,  IN ADDITION, CLIENT MAY BE SUBJECT TO A NEW PETITION BASED UPON AVIOLATION OF A COURT ORDER,COURT FINDS GOOD CAUSE AND REINSTATES PAROLE ON03-06-14 WITHOUT ANY TIME LOSS,/X:PAROLEE ORDERED TO REPORT TO PAROLE UPON RELEASE AND COMPLY WITH TREATMENT PER PAROLE AGENT,/
